articles.title: It just got way more expensive to rent gyms at Toronto and York Region public schools. Here's why
articles.summary: Some sports groups are slamming Toronto and York Region's public school boards for hiking permit fees on facility rentals like gyms, saying the move could price local groups out of accessing public space for community events.

articles.title: Teen dead after being shot in North York: police
articles.summary: A teen boy is dead after he was shot in North York Monday afternoon, Toronto police say.

articles.title: Man in his 60s injured in Etobicoke e-bike collision
articles.summary: Toronto police say a man in his 60s was injured after his e-bike crashed with a vehicle in Etobicoke Monday afternoon. The collision occurred around 3:06 p.m. in The Queensway and Grand Avenue area, near Park Lawn Road. Police said the man was transported to hospital by paramedics with non-life-threatening injuries. articles.summary: A teenage boy has died after he was shot in North York on Monday afternoon. Toronto police were called to Jane Street and Finch Avenue West just after 3:30 p.m. for reports of a shooting. Officers located the victim, a teenage boy, who was transported to a hospital, and later pronounced deceased. Speaking to reporters, […]

articles.title: Crews douse vehicle fire after crash on Gardiner Expressway
articles.summary: The Gardiner Expressway’s westbound lanes have reopened after being closed following a two-vehicle collision on Monday afternoon. Emergency services were called to the expressway just after 3 p.m. for reports of a two-vehicle crash and vehicle fire. Police say no injuries were reported, all westbound lanes of the Gardiner have reopened late Monday afternoon.

articles.title: Over 1,000 protesters demonstrate against Carney's investment summit in Toronto
articles.summary: More than 1,000 demonstrators gathered in downtown Toronto on Monday to protest against an investment summit organized by Prime Minister Mark Carney.

articles.title: Mississauga mayoral race heats up with focus on AI data centres
articles.summary: Mississauga’s mayoral race shifted into high gear this weekend, as four of the leading candidates officially kicked off their campaigns, with the issue of AI data centres taking centre stage.

articles.title: Motorcyclist killed in crash with car in Scarborough: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say a motorcyclist is dead after a two-vehicle collision in Scarborough Sunday afternoon.

articles.title: 'I never felt the pressure': Guerrero Jr. finally hits first homer of season at Rogers Centre in win over Os
articles.summary: For the first time this season, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has homered north of the border. The 2023 Home Run Derby champion, Guerrero connected off Baltimore's Trevor Rogers in the fifth inning of Sunday's 8-1 win.

articles.title: 17th annual Cruisin' For A Cure car show held in Brampton
articles.summary: The 17th annual Cruisin' For A Cure Canada car show was held in Brampton, Ont., Sunday. The event offered free prostate cancer tests for men over the age of 40 and also raised awareness of the importance of early detection. CBC's Tyler Cheese has the story.

articles.title: 11 names added to MADD Ontario monument for impaired driving victims
articles.summary: Families of victims, community members, police officers and survivors of impaired driving gathered in Brampton Saturday for a ceremony, where 11 new names were added to an Ontario memorial that honours victims of alcohol and drug-involved crashes.
